description: This Java class 'DeviceSpecificV19' extends 'DeviceSpecificV16' and provides device-specific implementations for API level 19, including gesture detection and input method subtype creation.

classes.name: DeviceSpecificV19
classes.description: A class providing device-specific behavior for API level 19, extending DeviceSpecificV16.

methods.name: createGestureDetector
methods.description: Creates and returns a new AskV19GestureDetector with the provided context and listener.

methods.name: createSubtype
methods.description: Creates an InputMethodSubtype using the provided locale and keyboard ID.

methods.name: buildAndFillSubtypeBuilder
methods.description: Builds and fills an InputMethodSubtypeBuilder with specific properties based on locale and keyboard ID.

methods.name: calculateSubtypeIdFromKeyboardId
methods.description: Calculates a subtype ID based on the hash of the keyboard ID string.
